tests.name: sax_custom_float_text
tests.intent: Verify that a custom SAX handler receives the exact text of float tokens during parsing.

tests.name: sax_acceptor_float_behavior
tests.intent: Verify that json::accept successfully accepts floats without failure or unnecessary evaluation.

tests.name: sax_dom_parser_floats
tests.intent: Verify that standard DOM parsing correctly processes floats and outputs them properly.

tests.name: stream_window_float_parse
tests.intent: Verify that parsing from a std::istream window correctly parses float tokens.

tests.name: derived_dom_parser_sax
tests.intent: Verify that a user-defined SAX handler derived from json_sax_dom_parser functions correctly with floats.

tests.name: multiple_floats_contiguous
tests.intent: Verify parsing of consecutive floating-point numbers in a contiguous input array.

tests.name: extreme_float_values
tests.intent: Verify that edge-case float values like very large or very small exponents parse correctly.

tests.name: negative_zero_float
tests.intent: Verify parsing of negative zero and negative floating-point numbers.

tests.name: callback_parser_floats
tests.intent: Verify that json_sax_dom_callback_parser correctly processes float values with a callback function.

tests.name: float_in_object_fields
tests.intent: Verify parsing of float values mixed with string keys and other object properties.

tests.name: nested_arrays_floats
tests.intent: Verify parsing of floats inside deeply nested arrays.

tests.name: accept_invalid_float_syntax
tests.intent: Verify that invalid float syntax is correctly rejected by json::accept.

tests.name: sax_parse_iterator_range
tests.intent: Verify sax_parse using a pair of iterators over a contiguous string containing floats.

tests.name: ordered_json_float_parse
tests.intent: Verify that ordered_json parses floats correctly preserving insertion order.

tests.name: parser_class_explicit_instantiation
tests.intent: Verify explicit instantiation and usage of nlohmann::detail::parser with a string input adapter.

tests.name: float_parser_with_exponent
tests.intent: Verify parsing of numbers with various scientific notation exponents.

tests.name: parse_with_exceptions_flag
tests.intent: Verify parsing with allow_exceptions = false when encountering malformed floats.

tests.name: float_token_string_input_adapter
tests.intent: Verify direct usage of span_input_adapter with basic_json::parse for floats.

tests.name: mixed_integers_and_floats
tests.intent: Verify correct distinction and parsing of integers versus floats in a mixed array.

tests.name: accept_stream_input
tests.intent: Verify json::accept using a std::istream source containing floats.

tests.name: gen_01
tests.intent: Verify that a custom SAX handler calls get_string() on float tokens, exercising the pending_number_text lazy copy mechanism and number_float_text(std::false_type).

tests.name: gen_02
tests.intent: Verify that parsing floats via a std::istream window exercises the bulk_window true branch where the float text is copied immediately.

tests.name: gen_03
tests.intent: Verify the sax_ignores_number_text trait structure directly using std::integral_constant and is_base_of or explicit template checks for custom handlers vs built-in handlers.

tests.name: gen_04
tests.intent: Verify that scan_number falls back to convert_number when parsing numbers that fail float conversion or take non-float paths, exercising token_buffer.append in scan_number_bulk_contiguous.

tests.name: gen_05
tests.intent: Verify that string tokens (object keys and string values) correctly invoke get_string_token() without any pending number text assertions failing, tested via sax_parse with a custom SAX handler.
